verification_report.summary: All assertions in the companion section are correct under the stated canonical inputs. The audit verified the normalized density, strict positivity at all cone faces, the 24π coefficient, the zero-potential identification with the fixed-density variational scalar, nef limiting and density-independence steps, the three logarithmic orders, and compact-fiber descent of sections including a=0 and/or b=0. The text correctly avoids identifying the fixed-density scalar with raw Monge–Ampère masses over all potentials and makes no general numerical-dimension claim.
